title: Reconciliation and Repair Worker for Scheduled Usage Exports
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a background reconciliation and repair service that validates scheduled customer usage export deliveries (CSV/NDJSON) after delivery and, when discrepancies are detected, runs an automated repair or creates a deterministic repair task. The worker covers S3 direct uploads (signed multipart), webhook deliveries, and interim manifest entries. Goals: detect silent corruption or truncation, ensure row-count and checksum consistency, surface actionable alerts to on-call and the Console UI, and provide safe idempotent replay paths for repaired exports.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Reconciliation worker runs for completed shipments and validates file size, row count, and sha256 checksum against stored manifest for at least 95% of exports in staging. 2) When mismatch is detected, a repair task is created in the repair queue with a reproducible steps list; repair succeeds end-to-end for a seeded test tenant. 3) Repair operations are idempotent and logged to the exports audit table with links to repair artifacts. 4) Console shows a 'repair-needed' flag and a downloadable diff for affected exports. 5) Pager alert triggers only when repair failure rate > 5% in a 1-hour window.
tasks:
- Design reconciliation schema (manifest entries, post-delivery probes)
- Implement worker: scan, validate (size/rows/sha256), emit findings
- Repair primitives: multipart reassemble, row-level redelivery, webhook requeue
- Add audit rows and repair metadata to exports table
- Integrate with Console: flag, diff view, repair action button
- Add metrics & dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana): validation_rate, repair_rate, repair_latency
- E2E tests: seeded tenant + simulated partial upload + network partition
- Runbook and oncall playbook, link to incident template
- Security review for signed URL replay behavior
notes:
- Motivation: recent customer incident (postmortem ENG-2026-INC-12) where a large CSV had a truncated final record after a multipart upload retry. The issue was only detected when customer attempted to import and reported mismatch.
- Trade-offs considered: 1) Validate via S3 object metadata vs streaming row-count—chosen to compute checksum+row-count at delivery time and persist in manifest to keep validation deterministic. 2) Aggressive auto-repair vs analyst-reviewed repair: implement conservative auto-repair for clear checksum mismatches (replay from canonical event store) and queue analyst review for ambiguous diffs.
- Performance: reconciliation runs in background and is rate-limited by tenant to avoid overloading the export pipeline; heavy tenants are sampled first.
- Privacy: repair artifacts redact PII by default; redaction function plug-in used for export profiles with sensitive columns.

change_log:
2026-02-18: ticket created by Ava Chen describing scope and measurements.
2026-02-25: design review with PM and Security; security requested explicit signed-URL replay guardrails.
2026-03-03: prototype worker validated on staging tenant 'acme-inc' for 24h window; found 3 mismatches (2 auto-repaired, 1 analyst review).
2026-03-10: added idempotency tokens and repair audit hooks; assigned to Miguel Torres for implementation and rollout.
review_feedback:
- PM (Liam Patel): prefer visible repair audit trail in Console and an option to opt-out auto-repair per tenant.
- Design (Priya Rao): ensure diff UI uses streaming diff to avoid loading large files into browser.
- Security (Jordan Mills): require one-time-use replay tokens and KMS audit on any exported repair bundles.
qa_strategy:
- Integration test that intentionally truncates multipart upload and asserts repair worker detects and replays.
- Load test with 5000 export shipments/day to validate worker backpressure settings.
- Chaos test: S3 500 errors injected during validation to ensure transient errors do not trigger false positives.
rollback_plan:
- Feature gated by console-repair feature flag.
- If repair causes regressions: disable auto-repair and run repair in 'dry-run' mode while keeping detection alerts active.
- Roll back DB schema additions by reverting migration id '20260301_exports_repair_manifest' if necessary.
observability_notes:
- Key metrics: exports.reconciliation.validations_total, exports.repair.attempts_total, exports.repair.success_rate, exports.repair.latency_seconds.
- Add tracing spans for validation -> repair path with tenant_id and shipment_id tags.
- Create Grafana alert: repair_failure_rate > 0.05 for 1h -> PagerDuty escalation to Export-Oncall.
related_customers:
- Acme Inc (reported truncated CSV import failure)
- Nimbus Health (requested guaranteed per-shipment integrity for audits)
